ITEM 1 | Square white plate, about 26 cm across, used as the scale reference; rectangular-ish outline, food occupies roughly 75% of its surface | 0
ITEM 2 | Stuffed or breaded roll-like pieces, golden-tan to brown crumb coating with visible chunks of kernels and small diced bits, one cut face showing pale cream filling, shape irregular, roughly 5-6 cm long pieces, moderately firm, dry-looking exterior, sitting at upper-left of plate | 150
ITEM 3 | Seared meat slices, medium brown with darker browned edges, glossy juices on surface, sliced into thin pieces about 6-8 cm long and 1 cm thick, fanned across upper-right of plate, moist and fibrous looking | 120
ITEM 4 | Caramelized onion strands, translucent amber to light brown, soft and limp, glossy with a light sheen of oil or juices, tangled over the meat slices | 35
ITEM 5 | Mixed green salad leaves, bright to dark green with some ruffled lighter edges, fresh-looking, slightly wilted, spread across lower-center and lower-right, covering about 20% of plate | 45
ITEM 6 | Single whole green herb leaf, dark glossy green, about 6 cm long, lying across top of meat | 2
ITEM 7 | Small dark red-purple pieces, possibly dried fruit or berries, glossy and slightly wrinkled, about 1-2 cm, clustered beneath the salad at bottom edge | 8
ITEM 8 | Scattered small yellow kernels and crumbs with bits of green herb sprinkled over the stuffed pieces, dry and matte | 5
